meta.name: agency-issue
meta.description: File, view, comment on, and close issues against the-agency framework on GitHub. Two-way channel with persisted local audit trail in `usr/{principal}/reports/`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 the-agency 框架的 GitHub issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 the-agency 框架并需要管理其 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Manage GitHub issues for the-agency framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with the-agency framework and need to handle its issues.

howto.what: Claude 可以代表你在 the-agency 框架的 GitHub 仓库上执行操作：提交新 issue、查看现有 issue、添加评论、关闭 issue。每次提交都会在本地 `usr/{principal}/reports/` 目录生成带元数据的 Markdown 报告。
howto.when: 当你或 Claude 在使用 the-agency 框架时遇到 bug、缺失功能、文档缺口等问题，并希望将它记录到框架的 GitHub issue 追踪器中时触发。

say.text: 我想针对 the-agency 框架的搜索功能提一个 bug。
帮我把 the-agency 仓库的 open issues 列出来。
say.note: Claude 会调用 list 子命令并展示结果。

say.text: 为 issue #47 添加一条评论，内容是我复现了这个问题。

howto.what_en: Claude can file, view, comment on, and close issues on the the-agency framework GitHub repo. Each filed issue writes a Markdown audit report to `usr/{principal}/reports/` with metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you or Claude encounter friction with the the-agency framework (bug, missing feature, doc gap, etc.) and want to record it in the framework's GitHub issue tracker.

say_en.text: File a bug about the search feature in the-agency framework.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the structured issue body and submit to GitHub.

say_en.text: List open issues from the the-agency repo.
say_en.note: Claude uses the list subcommand and displays results.

say_en.text: Add a comment to issue #47 saying I reproduced this.
say_en.note: Claude calls the comment subcommand with your message.
